It feels more like a necessary skill than a source of joy, though I recognize its importance in many fields.

If D > 0, there are two real solutions: x = [-b ± √D] / 2a. If D = 0, one real solution: x = -b/2a. If D < 0, two complex solutions. Check your solutions by substituting back. Remember to simplify fractions and radicals. Practice with different coefficients to build confidence.
